label: 1x16 PLC splitter, SC/APC, pre-connectorised
description: 1x16 balanced planar-lightwave-circuit splitter with SC/APC connectors on the input and all sixteen output legs, 1260-1600 nm. Insertion loss <=14.1 dB (pre-connectorised), uniformity <=1.2 dB, PDL <=0.30 dB, return loss >=55 dB. Fully passive: it carries GPON and XGS-PON wavelengths transparently and has no table to learn into.
notes: Prysmian AC005 issue 06, pre-connectorised table: 1x16 insertion loss <=14.1 dB, uniformity <=1.2, PDL <=0.30, RL/directivity >=55 dB, 1260-1600 nm, max input 500 mW, pigtails 1.5 m. Part number XSPSG00009 is the SC/APC input-and-output variant; the same splitter is XSPSG00004 unconnectorised (<=13.5 dB - the connectors cost 0.6 dB, which is the number to look at when someone asks why pre-terminated costs budget). Design note: the simulator's PON budget charges the ratio's worst-case catalogue figure (14.2 dB for 1:16) rather than this part's 14.1 dB, so a plan built on this splitter is 0.1 dB pessimistic, never optimistic.
